EmailTemplate.description: Forgot Password email of the Partner Portal site (Administration, Emails): sent when a partner chooses Forgot Password? on the login page, with the link to choose a new password.
EmailTemplate.name: Partner Portal Forgot Password
EmailTemplate.subject: Reset your John Keells Properties Partner Portal password
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Receiving_User.FirstName} {!Receiving_User.LastName},
A password reset was requested for your John Keells Properties Partner Portal login. Choose a new password to continue.
Your username: {!Receiving_User.Username}
Reset your password here: {!Community_Url}
The link works once and for a limited time. If it has expired, open the Partner Portal login page and choose "Forgot Password?" to get a new one. If you did not ask for a new password, please tell the John Keells Properties CP team.
Thanks, John Keells Properties
This is an automated message from the John Keells Properties Partner Portal.
